title: World Meteorological Organization
definition: The World Meteorological Organization (WMO) is a specialized agency of the United Nations dedicated to international cooperation on meteorology (weather and climate), operational hydrology, and related geophysical sciences.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for UPSC Civil Services Examination under GS Paper II (International Organizations, UN Agencies) and GS Paper III (Environment, Disaster Management, Climate Change, Economic development via early warning systems).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and institutional mechanisms of the World Meteorological Organization.
Evaluate spatial distribution, UN system integration, and global climate monitoring frameworks.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions regarding WMO reports and specialized bodies.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of United Nations specialized agencies
Core concepts of global climate change and atmospheric science
